hero.subtitle: GOLF AL MAR designs essential gear for the professional and amateur golfer — finest sport sunscreen and the legendary DOLO Golf, born from elite play, made for everyone on course.

brand.title: Part of the golfer's world.
brand.body: The world of golf is growing — and GOLF AL MAR is part of it. Developed in 2013 for the needs of amateur and professional golfers, our mission is simple: provide exceptional products that enhance the experience and let you enjoy the game even more.

sun.title: Five hours unprotected.
sun.body: Most golfers don't have adequate sun protection. Skin cancer is a growing problem. On the course you're exposed to wind, rain and sun for hours — burned noses, chins and arms come standard. Our finest sport sunscreen is non-greasy, non-slip, and made for an active lifestyle.

grip.title: When the grip slips, the game slips.
grip.body: Humid, hot, sweaty or rainy — golf grips lose hold fast. The MAGIC GOLF GRIP is our solution: a highly efficient formula designed and inspired by elite amateur and professional players, for a drier, grippier, more solid hold on every club.

sport-sunscreen.name: Golfers Pro Sunscreen — SPF 30
sport-sunscreen.shortDescription: Pharmaceutical-grade SPF 30 designed for golfers — sweat-resistant, non-slip, non-greasy. Blocks 96.6% of UVB. One application lasts all day.
sport-sunscreen.longDescription:
On the course, you're exposed to wind, rain and sun for at least five hours — often during the strongest UV window of the day. The result, after years of play: burned noses and arms, photo-aging, and a measurable rise in skin cancer risk. Most golfers simply don't have adequate sun protection.

GOLF AL MAR Golfers Pro Sunscreen was developed exclusively to close that gap. Pharmaceutical-grade SPF 30, blocking 96.6% of damaging UVB. Sweat-resistant, non-slip, non-greasy — one application lasts all day, so you can focus on the round, not on reapplying.
sport-sunscreen.sensitiveBody: GOLF AL MAR Golfers Sunscreen is ideal for sensitive skin. Recommended for those at increased risk of photo-damage, with a family history of skin cancer, or using medications that increase UV sensitivity. Daily protection from damaging sun-rays remains one of the best methods to retain young, healthy skin.
features: Helps shield your DNA from UVA and UVB induced damage
Moisturising while protecting the skin from sunburn

magic-golf-grip.name: Golfers Pro Magic Grip
magic-golf-grip.shortDescription: Performance grip enhancer for hot, humid, sweaty and rainy rounds. A grippier, drier, more solid hold on every club — inspired by elite amateurs and tour professionals.
magic-golf-grip.longDescription:
Golfers Pro Magic Grip is your answer when conditions try to take the grip away from you. The moment your hands — or your grip — lose contact, the swing comes apart. Hot. Humid. Sweaty. Rain on the back nine.

We developed a technology that enhances the grip of the hands — restoring the confidence, the consistency, and the simple enjoyment of the round. Whether you're new to the game or competing at the highest level as a tour professional, having the right gear is critical to playing your best golf.

A highly efficient formula, inspired by elite amateur and professional players. The goal: improve your grip, improve your game, and enjoy it even more.
magic-golf-grip.useBody: Designed to perform when the round gets tough — driving rain, high humidity, midday heat, or that 14th-hole sweat. Apply to clean, dry hands before the tee. Re-apply between holes if conditions demand it.
features: Performs in rain, humidity, heat and sweat
Inspired by elite amateurs and tour professionals
Fast-drying — no residue on grips or gloves
Won't damage clubs, gloves or grip wraps
For every level — beginner to tour pro
magic-golf-grip.promise: Improve your grip. Improve your game.

dolo-golf.name: DOLO Golf FORTE — Joint & Muscle Relief Cream
dolo-golf.shortDescription: A botanical anti-inflammatory cream built for golfers. Calms pain, accelerates recovery, supports joint longevity — without synthetic actives.
dolo-golf.descriptionTitle: Golf is more than a good swing
dolo-golf.longDescription:
Golf looks effortless. A calm tee shot, a walk across the course, focus over the putt.

But anyone who plays regularly knows: 18 holes ask a great deal of the body.
dolo-golf.useTitle: Your body plays every round with you
dolo-golf.useBody:
A golf swing is a complex movement. Feet, legs, hips, torso, shoulders, arms and hands all have to work together precisely within a few seconds.

That movement is repeated again and again over a round.

As the round goes on, fatigue can set in. Movements start to feel less easy, concentration can slip, and muscles and joints come under greater strain.
features: Supports muscle recovery and tissue repair
Helps protect joints from long-term wear
Non-greasy — won't transfer to grip or glove
No synthetic actives. No menthol burn.
dolo-golf.promise: Play better. Play longer. Play without pain.

longevity-support.name: LONGEVITY SUPPORT
longevity-support.shortDescription: A daily longevity formula built for golfers who plan to play for decades. 75% vegan protein and functional ingredients for sustained energy, faster recovery, and joint resilience — every round, every year.
longevity-support.longDescription:
Golf is a long game. Five hours on your feet, two hundred high-torque rotations, and a body that needs to keep delivering thirty years from now. The amateurs who still swing freely in their seventies — and the pros who stay competitive season after season — share one habit: they treat their body like the equipment it is.

LONGEVITY SUPPORT is a premium daily formula engineered around 75% vegan protein and a focused stack of functional ingredients. Cordyceps for sustained energy and endurance. Boswellia serrata for joint and connective-tissue support. Ginger for daily anti-inflammatory wellbeing. Agave inulin for gut and metabolic health. Acerola for natural vitamin C and cellular protection. One scoop, every day.

Built for golfers who want to stay strong, recover faster between rounds, and keep playing their best golf for the next decades — not just this season.
longevity-support.useBody: After 40, the body recovers slower, builds muscle harder, and absorbs each round more deeply. The golfers who keep their swing into their sixties and seventies are the ones who supplement consistently — daily protein, daily anti-inflammatory support, daily micronutrients. LONGEVITY SUPPORT was developed exactly for this.
features: Natural vitamin C for cellular protection
longevity-support.promise: Play stronger. Recover faster. Play longer.

about.title: About GOLF AL MAR
about.welcomeBody:
GOLF AL MAR grew out of a passion for golf and one simple thought:
Why is there specialised equipment for almost every situation on the course, yet so few products built around the particular needs of the golfer?

A round asks for more than a good swing. Hours of movement, sun and heat, changing weather, and the repeated load on hands, muscles and joints are all part of the game.

That is exactly where GOLF AL MAR begins.
about.intro: We develop specialised premium products for golfers, with one aim: to support performance, protection, recovery and well-being on and off the course.
about.pullQuote: Whatever carries the GOLF AL MAR name has to add real value to the game.
about.originTitle: Thought up by golfers. Built for the game.
about.originBody:
Our product ideas don't come from a desk alone. They come from the course.

On the first tee. After hours in the sun. When hands turn damp. When muscles and joints have taken a long round. And when you want to play again the next morning.

We watch what golfers actually need, and build products that serve a concrete purpose.
about.missionBody:
For us, a better game doesn't only mean a lower handicap.

It means feeling good through an entire round. Protecting your skin from intense sun. Keeping a secure grip. Supporting muscles and joints. Recovering better afterwards, and enjoying golf for as long as possible.

So we look at the golfer as a whole — from the first tee to the last putt, and far beyond the round.
about.valuesIntro: Three principles guide every product we bring to the course.

values.title: Performance
values.body: A secure grip, a clear head and a body that stays with you for 18 holes. Our products are built to support the game where it is actually played.

values.title: Protection
values.body: Hours of sun, wind and changing weather are part of every round. We protect skin, hands and joints from exactly the strain the game brings.

values.title: Recovery
values.body: After the round is before the round. We help muscles and joints recover — so you can play again the next morning.

about.productsBody:
Golf is one of the few sports that can stay with people for decades.

That is precisely what fascinates us.

Our philosophy is therefore not aimed only at the next round. We build products that help golfers stay active, mobile and capable, and enjoy their game for as long as possible.

That is what we mean by the long game.
about.craftBody:
We combine selected high-quality natural award-winning ingredients, modern product development and the practical experience of golfers.

Every development starts with a simple question: what does a golfer really need?

And it ends with a second one: would we carry this product in our own bag?

Only when the answer convinces does it belong to GOLF AL MAR.
about.noteBody:
The best moment in golf is the one where you don't have to think about your equipment.

You feel the club.
You see the fairway.
You focus on the next shot.
And you enjoy the people you share the round with.

The equipment should disappear.
The round should be remembered.

That is GOLF AL MAR.
about.noteSignoff: GOLF AL MAR ..... made to improve your game
